title: cruster timeline (NDJSON record)
description: Merged chronological event stream for a pod. Two record shapes: per-fact `record` and a single terminal `summary` carrying window, counts, and `kinds_absent` (negative-evidence field). v1 supports pod refs only.

source.description: Where this record came from. `type=event` for kube events (carries event uid, reason, type); `type=derived` for facts computed from manifest state (carries jsonpath); `type=managed_fields` for config rotation records (carries ref to the rotated object).

target.description: Optional sub-resource the record concerns (container name, field path, etc.).

attrs.description: Kind-specific structured payload. For `restarted`/`oom_killed`: restart_count, prev_exit_code, prev_reason, signal, alive_seconds. For `secret_rotated`/`configmap_changed`: resource_version, consumed_by[].

message.description: Verbatim event message string for event-derived records; null otherwise. Never paraphrased.

kinds_absent.description: Record kinds (from the catalog, excluding generic_event) that produced zero records in this window. Negative-evidence field — the calling agent should not re-check these.

notes.description: Soft synthesis is restricted to this field — used for cluster-config caveats (event TTL) and unavoidable trivial observations. Never causal claims.
